description: Get the receipt of a mined Optimism transaction: success or reverted, gas used, effective gas price, fee paid in ETH, number of event logs and any contract created. Use to confirm a payment or call went through; for sender, value and calldata use op_tx. Input is a 0x-prefixed 64-hex hash; a pending or unknown hash returns 404, uncharged. Example: hash=0x721f3e9a996da49e2a8929bd2dd42e0f51344c11d7ca7bc3328fda349cdfae89. Price $0.003/call via x402 USDC or a card key (/credits), first 25 free; failed calls free. Reads or computes only and changes nothing; each call is charged, so repeats are not free.
name: op_receipt
title: Optimism transaction receipt
